name: SegmentedBar
usage: Storage by file type, time spent per phase, budget split, the split of a figure in a table row

props.name: items
props.description:
The parts, in the order of the blocks. Each keeps the color of its position (or its `slot`) even when
another part is 0 and not drawn. Negative or non-finite values cannot be part of a whole: the bar is then
shown empty (with a warning in development). When every value is 0 the bar is empty too.

props.name: label
props.description: What the whole is, such as "Storage by file type". Screen readers read it before the parts.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`tall` (28 px): a bar standing alone, with the share or amount printed in each block that has room for it
and a legend. `thin` (8 px): a bar next to the figures it splits (in a table row or above a list), without
text or legend.

props.name: dense
props.description: Makes the thin bar 4 px high, for dense table rows.

props.name: show
props.description: What the tall blocks print: the `share` of the whole (46%) or the `value` (413M, written with `format`).

props.name: format
props.description: How amounts are written, in the blocks (with `show="value"`), the tooltip and the accessible names.

props.name: maxItems
props.description:
The most parts shown, "Other" included (2–8). Past it, the parts after the first `maxItems - 1` are folded
into "Other" in the de-emphasis color, so order the items with the ones to keep first.

props.name: legend
props.description:
Shows a legend under the bar: the names in block order, without numbers. On by default for `tall`, off for
`thin` (in a table, use one legend for the whole table).

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows a skeleton in place of the bar (and of the legend, when there is one) while the data loads; the size
does not change when the data arrives. Like Statistic, the skeleton appears after 200 ms, so fast loads do not
flash.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the part, shown in the legend and the tooltip and read by screen readers.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Amount of the part: a finite number, 0 or more.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: Chart color (1–8). By default the n-th item uses the n-th chart color.

types.name: ValueFormat
types.summary:
How a value is written.
- `'auto'`: in full below 10,000, compact from 10,000 on (1,284 · 12.9K · 4.2M).
- `'number'`: always in full, with grouping separators.
- `'compact'`: always compact.
- `'percent'`: the value is a ratio (0.125 → 12.5%).
- a function: your own formatting (units, currencies).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
A tall bar standing alone: each block prints its share where it fits, and the legend lists the names in block
order. Hover a block, or press `Tab` and then `←` / `→`, to see its amount, share and name.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Amounts and folding
examples.description:
`show="value"` prints the amount instead of the share. Past `maxItems` parts (6 by default), the tail is folded
into "Other", in the de-emphasis color.

examples.name: Thin
examples.title: Thin, next to its figures
examples.description:
The thin bar has no text: the figures are beside it. In table rows, use `dense` (4 px) and give the whole table
one legend, here on the bar of the total.

examples.name: Empty
examples.title: No data
examples.description:
Without parts, or when every part is 0, the bar is an empty track of the same height. Negative or non-finite
values are treated the same way, with a warning in development.
